'''Fannatex''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the apprentice of [[Mahish]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Mahish brought Fannatex with him to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] when he was hunting the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Fellil]], but Fannatex was forced to recruit outside help when Mahish was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] mercenaries.
